import hashlib,pathlib

print('endswith single LF:', b.endswith(b'\n') and not b.endswith(b'\n\n'))
print('CRLF present:', b'\r' in b)
print(repr(b[-80:]))
"

input.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess
A='.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py'
for args in (['audit','output.md','--level','3','--scope=format','--json'],
             ['verify','input.md','output.md','--scope=format'],
             ['verify','input.md','output.md','--scope=format','--json'],
             ['report','input.md','output.md','--scope=format']):
    r=subprocess.run(['python3',A]+args,capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('=== ',' '.join(args),' -> EXIT',r.returncode)
    print(r.stdout[:2500])
    if r.stderr.strip(): print('STDERR:',r.stderr[:500])
"
